blockers_addressed.fix: A sealed all8 record is not sufficient. Require finite paired candidate/reference measurements on seeds 1 and 2, graded candidate tapes, positive unit counts and completed required later-harm measurements. Preserve missing/failed per-seed status, clear stale success flags, expose incomplete counts and permit explicit fresh-decision recovery. Measured statistical rejections remain verified. None requires the complete measured paired support and reference on both seeds.

test_incomplete_seed2_record_cannot_certify_or_retain_stale_success: missing example, missing/nonfinite advantage, ungraded tape, missing later-harm measurement, missing reference total

blockers_addressed.fix: Freeze an independently supplied base-policy schedule and decision snapshot before dispatch. Build every member-second absolute command as base plus the concrete moves.offsets schedule. Bind the full execution metadata, profile, base profile, offset profile, member order, duration and snapshot identity to the submitted plan and sealed receipt. Nearest projection is never an equality certificate.

test_execution_metadata_tampering_rejected_even_with_valid_receipt_seal: base profile, offsets, execution metadata, duration, members and commitment truncation

test_execution_contract_full_offsets_base_identity_and_preparation: full schedule, independent base-plus-offset construction, snapshot mismatch, shortened schedule, frozen base/policy and missing preparation

api.config: split_config(cfg) removes and validates teacher keys in place; plan_config(cfg=None) resolves a copy; both return None while off. make_teacher refuses the off configuration.
api.factory_B: make_teacher(cfg, planner_kwargs={'rollout': cpu_rollout, 'calibration': fitted_calibration, 'config': optional_T1B_Config, 'calibrate': optional_T1C_function}) -> WMDenseTeacher
api.planner_adapter: planner_scorer binds planner_online.score_moves with an exact recorded candidate provider. It maps p_calibrated/expected_gain into p_better/gain without changing horizon or WM samples.
api.capture_and_label: DAggerBuffer(cadence_s).add(episode, step, t_s, cav, obs_state, candidates=recorded_table) snapshots learner decision states and tables; buffer.label(teacher) labels each once. teacher.label_state accepts the same recorded table directly.
api.CE: trigger_targets(labels, batch) checks exact candidate support/masks and returns candidate indices in batch.context['members'] order for TriggerPolicy.imitation_loss. candidate_class 0 is none, i+1 selects candidates[i]; action_class is only the auxiliary family/parameter-bucket target.
api.verification_selection: select_for_verification(labels, fraction) deterministically samples label ids with an order-independent Bernoulli hash
api.prepare_verification_plan: prepare_verification_plan(label, snapshot, base_profile=None, *, moves_mod=None, plan_id=None) freezes the exact execution contract before dispatch and returns a normal all8 absolute-profile plan. base_profile must be an independently recorded finite member-by-second base-policy schedule covering the full move; it is never inferred from the submitted plan. Concrete T1A Move/offsets constructs the complete offset schedule. None returns None and binds the actual policy-continues comparator. Preparation cannot change a previously frozen base schedule or snapshot.
api.verification_binding: bind_receipt(label, receipt, candidate_index, plan=None, moves_mod=None, *, replace_incomplete=False) validates receipt seal, training episode/time, exact prepared snapshot and execution, and candidate plan digest. Failed candidate branches are bound as incomplete, not completed measurements. moves_mod remains accepted for call compatibility; from_plan is not called.
api.verification_driver: verify_selected(labels, fraction, submit_first_seed, verifier, moves_mod=None, *, recover_incomplete=None). Dispatch prepares the exact contract and returns (sealed_receipt, index, plan), with None/None for none. Bound labels are reconsumed to refresh measurement status. Recovery is explicit, budgeted by the caller, requires a fresh verification id and the identical frozen execution/base snapshot, and archives previous bindings/failures in verification_history. Automatic redispatch is disabled.
api.all8: All8Verifier(...).flush delegates to existing confirm_pending_all8. consume attaches verification_seed_status and only sets verified after both required seeds are measured. Its summary separates sealed, verified, incomplete, missing and missing_seed_measurements. A missing/failed all8 example is incomplete, not a statistical rejection.
api.budget: verification_quote delegates to existing quote_decision arithmetic, using the maximum registered onset-plus-hold when duration is omitted and assuming all candidates admitted for an upper bound, including solos/extra seeds
api.dataset: build_dataset preserves full labels, per-seed failures, execution contracts and recovery history; counts includes selected, verified, incomplete and replicated. save_dataset/load_dataset use canonical JSON and a content seal. Legacy verification bindings without exact execution/measurement contracts are refused.

semantics.B_selection: Calibrated p_better >= p_star and positive expected gain; maximize gain with stable candidate-order ties; otherwise none
semantics.lookahead: The concrete T1B adapter retains its full registered 600-second look-ahead and paired WM sample count
semantics.R_fairness: Same candidate generator, budget, windows, observable-member checks and recorded-table handling as B; separate random-choice RNG preserves the matched proposal stream; R labels uniformly over support plus none without WM scoring
semantics.observables: Allowlisted sensing/V2V rows and actor-only belief/history inputs. T2C supplies actual local timestamp-aligned visibility; hidden row extras and unknown top-level fields are stripped.
semantics.verified: Completed measured paired outcomes on both required seeds, including statistical and measured safety/later-harm rejections; distinct from admitted or cooperative
semantics.none: Requires complete paired support and the policy comparator on both seeds; never uses an empty candidate-match list as proof of completion
semantics.execution: The current all8 executor consumes absolute profiles. The contract certifies the supplied base schedule plus exact move offsets before the existing feasibility/ownership clamp. The caller supplies the actual base-policy schedule from the same snapshot; no unrecorded future feedback trajectory is inferred or certified.
semantics.recovery: Existing all8 seals and receipts remain immutable. A missing or failed measurement stays incomplete until explicitly resubmitted under a fresh decision id; old failures remain in label history.
